physDesc.physMedium: Bound in cardboard cover with marbled sides and brown spine. In the middle of the front cover a handwritten label in Emil Erslev's hand, inscribed: "Ved Solnedgang / Digt af A. Munch / for Chor og Orchester / Op 46 / Partitur". Written in ink. Paper: 16 staves. Paginated 2-18. Page 18 blank; last page blank and unnumbered. Title page information written in the left-hand margin of the first unnumbered music page. At the end of the music Gade has written: "Comp. August 1863. / Inst. Marz 186 5" and his musical signature.
